about: v2: Around the Hive. One small world with the Hive at its centre and four lands around it, one per page (gold, blue, green, violet). Amber is always the light; each land's own colour lives in its ground, plants, water and shadows. Day shows in light mode, night in dark mode; every night is an edit of its day.
style: Cozy 8-bit pixel art like Stardew Valley and A Short Hike. Chunky sprites on a strict grid: one art pixel is about 6 image pixels at 2048 px wide, 1-pixel stair-stepped plum-brown #301d26 outlines, flat cel shading with at most three tones per surface. No anti-aliasing, dithering, blur, airbrushed glow, light beams or painterly texture. Amber leads: honey #ffd76d and lamp amber #ffc766 are the only light colours (sun glints, lit windows, lamps, a few drifting pollen motes). The world's own colour lives in ground, foliage, water and shadow, never in the upper sky. Soft pastels; never neon, hot pink, navy or indigo. Image 1 is the character sheet: draw only the characters the scene names, exactly as drawn there, one of each, never copying its layout or background. Polli is about a fifth of the frame height, the Robot 1.1 times Polli, Nomnom 0.8 times Polli. No text, letters, logos, borders, moon or sun disc.

cast.polli: Polli the bee (one round honey-yellow #fcd45e ball a little wider than tall, never a capsule and never a head on a body; dark brown stripes on her back half, black vertical oval eyes, soft rose #f67fac rectangular blush, a small smile, small pale-blue wings, thin black antennae, tiny black legs)
cast.robot: the Robot (a peach-cream CRT-monitor head #edceaa with a dark slate glass screen showing two mint #9fe3b8 square eyes and a small smile, no blush and never orange; a small boxy cream body, stubby segmented grey arms and legs)
cast.nomnom: Nomnom (one round tan #dc9f66 mochi ball a little wider than tall, dot eyes, rosy cheeks, a wide happy mouth, no limbs except two tiny nubs when carrying something)
cast.hive: the Hive (a small honey-gold straw skep with one round glowing amber window)

day.prompt: Soft clear daylight from the upper right, off-frame; short soft shadows fall to the left. Honey-coloured sun glints on edges and leaves.

night.prompt: Image 1 is a finished daytime scene. Redraw image 1 at night: keep the exact composition, framing, every object, every character and pose, and the pixel grid; change only light and colour. The sky and any flat background become very dark warm charcoal #262420 at the edges, only faintly tinted by the world. Light comes only from the scene's own lamps, windows and glowing screens, in warm amber #ffc766. Sparse tiny warm stars, no moon, no navy or indigo. Keep the characters bright, readable and exactly as drawn on image 2, the character sheet.

hero.prompt: Wide banner. The left 60% and the top third are calm empty sky in the world's palest tint, fading to flat pale cream #fef8eb at the left and bottom edges. Scenery sits low on the right; the characters stand in the right third, between 30% and 70% of the height.

closing.prompt: Wide panorama for the bottom of a page. The top quarter is calm sky fading to flat pale cream #fef8eb at the top edge. Continuous ground across the whole width reaching the bottom edge, with no floating island, rim or border. The characters are in the middle 70% of the width, between 35% and 90% of the height.

card.prompt: Wide illustration for the bottom of a card. The top quarter fades to flat off-white #fffefb; the scene sits in the lower three quarters, centred, with continuous ground to the bottom edge.

tile.prompt: One centred subject inside the middle half of the frame; every edge is flat plain background so any crop works.

home.look: Hive Hill: a honey-wheat hill with clover and sunflowers around the Hive, and a small mint-glass greenhouse. Colour cast: gold over soft sage, the most amber of the four lands.
home.night: Its lights: the Hive's round window and bee-door glow amber and spill onto the wheat, the greenhouse is lit from inside, a few amber fireflies.

play.look: Sea-glass Cove: a painter's open-air studio on a sun-bleached wooden pier over a calm lagoon, with the Hive small on a far island. Colour cast: sea-glass blue water, a pale blue horizon and periwinkle shadows, the coolest of the four lands, with warm wooden boards.
play.night: Its lights: amber pier lanterns with long stepped reflections in the water, the Robot's mint screen eyes, the Hive a tiny amber dot reflected on the lagoon.

apps.look: Canopy Bazaar: a lane of little market stalls shaped like app windows, under giant monstera and banana leaves hung with lanterns. Colour cast: leaf green and jade shade with honey light patches on the lane; the one land where fresh lime green #ecf874 appears, on new leaf tips and stall title bars.
apps.night: Its lights: stall windows glow warm like app screens, lanterns hang from the vines, a few lime fireflies.

community.look: Lantern Hill: a hilltop village green with a noticeboard, raised idea beds, a vote box and a long table, ringed by a string of round bulbs; the Hive glows small in the valley below. Colour cast: heather violet and lilac in the shadows and distant hills, sage grass and a few apricot blossoms; lilac only near the horizon, never in the upper sky.
community.night: Its lights: the ring of bulbs fully lit with warm pools on the grass, a lantern on the noticeboard, the Robot's mint screen, more stars than any other land.

images.prompt: Four model-flowers grow in a raised bed in front of {hive}: one with speech-bubble leaves, one with picture-frame petals, a film-strip vine, and bell flowers puffing tiny music notes. Each sends a thin thread of honey-gold pollen into one small honey jar that {polli} carries as she flies toward the Hive.

The same hill as image 2, at the Hive's little bee-door. {robot} holds out a small brass key to {polli}. Beside them a small quest board holds three cards; the first card is ticked, and a gentle arc of honey-gold pollen flies from it into her honey jar.
At the greenhouse potting bench, {polli} and {robot} build a tiny glass greenhouse among pots of code-plants, tools and coiled hoses, with the big greenhouse behind them.

At the end of the pier, {robot} proudly holds up a small finished painting of the lagoon beside its wooden easel, eyes wide. {polli}, wearing a small painter's beret, hovers beside it holding a tiny brush. A mooring post holds a speech-bubble sign, a clapperboard and a pair of headphones. {hive} sits small on a far island.

Image 2 is the current closing scene: keep its long workbench, its stations, its layout and its pixel grid exactly. Change only this: the blank paper on the left becomes a small retro terminal printing a chat scroll whose end {nomnom} happily munches; the heartbeat monitor becomes a small gramophone with headphones hanging on it; the bee becomes {polli}, wearing a painter's beret, adding a brushstroke to the framed painting; the bushes behind become a pier rail with the lagoon of image 3 beyond.

Keep the layout of image 2: the lane of app-window stalls receding to the right and Nomnom's place in it. {nomnom} strolls the lane carrying one colourful app window. {polli}, wearing a little leaf hat, strings a line of lanterns between the first two stalls. Giant monstera leaves frame the top right, and {hive} peeks through a gap in the leaves.

Image 2 is the current scene: keep the noticeboard, the stalls, the cart and the layout. Change only this: the bee becomes {polli}, wearing a little leaf hat, hovering beside the board and pinning an app card (no longer standing on Nomnom); the round creature becomes {nomnom}; giant leaves frame the top corners and honey light patches fall on the lane, matching image 3.

world.night: Its light: the honey cells glow amber from inside, the frame dims to warm taupe, and the flat background becomes exactly #2a2826.

images.prompt: One chunky pixel app window with extra-chunky pixels (about 16 image pixels per art pixel): a cream frame with a honey title bar and three dots. Its screen is a honeycomb of about twelve wax cells: five full of glowing honey (#ffd76d to #ffc95a), the rest pale empty outlines, and one honey drop falling into the next empty cell. Flat plain #fffefb background. No characters and no cast shadow.

At the noticeboard on the green, {polli}, wearing a mint scarf, pins a sprout-drawing idea card; {robot} hands up the next card; {nomnom} sits by a basket of seed packets nibbling an old crumpled card. The bulb string on its posts is just switching on. {hive} sits small on a far violet hill in the right third. The whole scene, characters included, sits in the upper 60% of the frame; the bottom 40% is only soft grass fading to cream, because page cards overlap it.

Image 2 is the current scene: keep the idea beds, the vote box with its VOTE lettering, the lantern, the characters and the layout. Change only this: the two small round creatures become one full-size {nomnom} queuing with a ballot in his mouth; the robot becomes {robot}; the upper sky becomes calm cream with apricot only at the horizon; the grass becomes sage with heather; a bulb string hangs behind the beds, matching image 3.

There's a seat for you: a long wooden table on the green of image 2 under the ring of bulbs, set with cups and small plant pots, and one bench pulled out toward the viewer. {polli}, in her mint scarf, pours honey tea; {robot} sits beside her; {nomnom} happily munches the potluck. In the centre of the table the sprout from the idea card has bloomed in a pot.
